title: Portrait Photo Into Story Frame
tests: Tests creating a vertical story from a square portrait without clipping the person or distorting the photo.

faults.what: The image is tightly cropped at both sides, cutting off curls and most of the shoulder area that were visible in the source, contrary to the explicit preservation request.

judge.summary: The portrait fits a 9:16 frame but loses substantial shoulder area and some hair through a tight crop.

must_haves.item: The delivered image has a 9:16 vertical frame.
must_haves.why: The output has the requested tall 9:16 proportions.

must_haves.item: The sharp foreground portrait shows the same woman, curly hair and sweater as the attachment.
must_haves.why: The woman, curls, and gray knit sweater match the source.

must_haves.item: No hair or shoulder area visible in the source is lost.
must_haves.why: Both sides are cropped inward, removing outer curls and substantial portions of both shoulders.

must_haves.item: The portrait is not stretched or squeezed.
must_haves.why: The portrait appears uniformly enlarged and cropped, without visible proportional distortion.

must_haves.item: Any added background space uses a blurred version of the source photo, with no text.
must_haves.why: No background space was added and no text appears; the output instead fills the frame by cropping.
